acceptance: A several-minute successful cold start completes build.command without a manual retry.
Container and host HTTPS readiness use one bounded budget and progress heartbeat.
Exited containers, permanent timeout and wrong host identities never report success.
Owned initializing instances are waited for without recreation; outer build/desktop deadlines allow the readiness budget.

requirements.summary: User requests automatic completion of slow but successful post-build startup without manual retry.

design.summary: Shared 600s readiness budget configurable to 1..1800s, bounded probes, 15s progress, owned-instance reuse, actual exit detection, 2100s outer wrapper allowance.

implementation.summary: POSIX helper and entrypoint plus build/Mac wrappers updated; regression tests and contract documentation added.

verification.summary: 102 targeted regressions and complete offline resource check passed. A real build.command invocation completed automatically with exit=0 in 526.9s total; readiness progress reached 344/600s before automatic success. Both old 60-attempt and 240s outer limits were exceeded without abort or manual retry. Host TLS/instance checks passed. Optional post-build cache recycling skipped because Docker health status lagged behind direct HTTP readiness.

documentation.summary: Updated launcher contract with deadline, progress, override, ownership and failure behavior; linked issue #981 and recorded actual results.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed task-scoped diffs; temporary test containers cleaned by test harness. Existing user changes/data retained. Optional normal build cache recycling did not run because Docker health label had not yet refreshed.

release.summary: Local source build installed and validated; no commit, push, new version or public release.

rollback: Keep pre-change local runtime under aide:startup-readiness-before-20261122 until real startup validation completes.
handoff: Local startup false timeout fixed and validated with one complete build invocation. App remains at https://localhost:9999/. Startup can still take about six minutes, but now waits and completes without manual retry. Linux behavior covered by shell/fake-Docker tests; no physical Linux or Windows acceptance. Optional cache recycling was skipped on this run due to health-label lag.
